name: Back up your n8n workflows to Github

parameters.content:
## Backup to GitHub 
This workflow will backup all instance workflows to GitHub every 24 hours.

The files are saved into folders using `YYYY/MM/` for the directory path and `ID.json` for the filename.

The Repo Owner, Repo Name and Main folder are set using the **Variables** feature but can be replaced with the `Config` node in the subworkflow. 

The workflow runs calls itself to help reduce memory usage, Once the workflow has completed it will send an optional notification to Slack.

### Time to Run
Tested with 1423 workflows on `1.44.1` it took under 30 minutes for the first run and under 12 minutes once the initial run is complete.

json.name: Stock Radar

parameters.content:
## Stock Radar
Production research monitor — **no trading** (signals + alerts only).
Cron + manual · Finnhub + OpenAI · Google Sheets log · Slack / Discord / SMTP email.
Configure env vars + credentials after import (see chat deliverable).

## Inputs
**Google Sheet** watchlist tab with header row:
`ticker, company_name, sector, target_style, alert_threshold`

Optional: swap in **Manual Trigger → Set** with a JSON array for demos (bypass the first Sheets node).

## Collect (Finnhub)
4 GETs per ticker + **Wait** between tickers.
HTTP nodes: retries + continue on error (inspect partial runs).
Extend: add `stock/candle` for true volume / MA studies.

## Analyze
Deterministic score in **Code Composite Score** (transparent weights).
**OpenAI** returns structured JSON (summary, signals, red flags).

## Alerts
Instant: **IF** routes high-signal names → Slack → Discord webhook → SMTP (sequential; tame rate limits).
Digest: **Split In Batches** “done” output reads the log and posts top 5.
Disable channels you do not use.

## Storage + digest
Each ticker appends a row to **Stock Radar Log**.
Digest reads recent rows ≥ execution start, ranks by `composite_score`, posts **Top 5**.
**Notion / Airtable:** add a second append after the first Sheets append — map the same fields.
